claim: [Question] Is amazon ok for buying watches? : r/Watches - Reddit
summary: I have bought several watches from Amazon, ranging from G shocks and Orients to an Omega Speedmaster Sapphire Sandwich. Most recently I purchsed a Hamilton Intra-Matic Chronograph without any issues. I even sent in one of my watches (Hamilton Pilot Day Date) for repair under Amazon's warranty (provided through Asurion) and they fixed it for me.
